question: After the concrete patch blockers are repaired, should ai& be sponsored as a permanent built-in CodexBar provider?
rationale: This is a technically credible provider, but accepting a permanent credential surface and external API maintenance commitment is a repository product decision rather than an automated correctness judgment.

options.title: Sponsor after repairs
options.body: Accept ai& as a default-disabled built-in provider after macro registration, documentation cleanup, and a clean current-main rebase.

options.title: Decline built-in support
options.body: Close the PR without landing ai& if the repository should not assume its long-term provider maintenance burden.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repairs
recommendation.body: Accept ai& as a default-disabled built-in provider after macro registration, documentation cleanup, and a clean current-main rebase.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and the clearest provider-policy decision owner, steipete is best positioned to sponsor or decline permanent built-in support.
